<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="ripper-demons" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Ripper Demons</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line">[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ripper_Demon <nowiki>Ripper Demons</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107343123976284.png?v=1" alt="ripperdemon" title="ripperdemon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are one of the 4 Raptor specialty monsters, as such they boast mechanics that make engaging them more dangerous than normal mobs. They are mainly killed for Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> tasks, the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Kharidian_Desert <nowiki>Kharidian Desert collection log</nowiki>]<nowiki>, the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Parasitic_orb <nowiki>parasitic orb</nowiki>]<nowiki> which is used to unlock the Nipper demon pet, and for profit via creating </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1" alt="ripperpouch" title="ripperpouch" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ripper Demons can be assigned as a Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> assignment by Mandrith, Laniakea, Morvran, Kuradal, and The Raptor.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Demon cluster tasks also work, they may be assigned by Laniakea, and The Raptor.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Laniakea assigns almost </nowiki><strong><nowiki>twice</nowiki></strong><nowiki> as many.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This guide will focus on killing Ripper Demons via AOE methods as they yield the highest KPH; however, at lower levels it is suggested to kill them one at time in the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ripper_Demon_cave <nowiki>Ripper Demon cave</nowiki>]<nowiki> southeast of the Al Kharid lodestone </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552328005419038.png?v=1" alt="alkharidlode" title="alkharidlode" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bring your best Melee gear with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1130170689119326350.png?v=1" alt="darklight" title="darklight" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1" alt="vampscrim" title="vampscrim" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The </nowiki><em><nowiki>Midday</nowiki></em><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Skyboxes_and_filters <nowiki>skybox</nowiki>]<nowiki> helps brighten the area.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 96</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 2,721.6</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~930 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Low Effort), ~1700 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Low Effort)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: ~2.53M </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Low Effort), ~3.79M </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Low Effort)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Slaughter</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ When engaged from a distance, Ripper Demons will immediately teleport to the player and cast Slaughter </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879237873666.png?v=1" alt="slaughter" title="slaughter" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, which deals triple damage if you move.
    • This makes them extremely easy to stack up for AoE damage.
    • This also incentivises staying at the same spot when AoEing.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Death from above</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Ripper Demons gain adrenaline whenever they autoattack.
    • When the bar fills up, they will jump and land where the player was standing shortly after, dealing up to 32,000 hard typeless damage resulting in an instant kill.
    • This can be avoided by moving away from your original location immediately upon seeing them jump.
    • </nowiki><strong><nowiki>When AoEing, good DPM is crucial to avoid this mechanic.</nowiki></strong><nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Aggression</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ If the player is below 35% HP, all nearby Ripper Demons will immediately aggro to the player.
    • Usually, using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when low HP is desirable to prevent being stacked out.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Death spin</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ When killed, Ripper Demons will spin and hit any nearby players with weak rapid melee hits per tick in a 3x3 area, which can deal large damage if stood in.
    • This mechanic is the main reason </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1" alt="enhdev4" title="enhdev4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are essential for killing rippers.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Binding_contract <nowiki>Binding contracts</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073883118521557052.png?v=1" alt="bindingcontract" title="bindingcontract" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Magic_notepaper <nowiki>Magic notepaper</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735230908805240.png?v=1" alt="notepaper" title="notepaper" kind="icon" /><nowiki>

⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Oldak_coil <nowiki>Oldak coil</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><ins><nowiki>Location and How to Get there</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>The Wilderness</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If killing Ripper Demons in the Wilderness; they are located west of the Demonic Ruins / northeast of Red Dragon Isle, they are </nowiki><strong><nowiki>aggressive</nowiki></strong><nowiki> in this location. </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Ensure you disable PVP by speaking to </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Vala#Edgeville <nowiki>Vala</nowiki>]<nowiki> in Edgeville.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>1) How to get there in order of speed:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a) </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Annakarl_Teleport <nowiki>Annakarl Teleport (Ancient Magicks)</nowiki>]<nowiki> and run west, has a high chance of aggro'ing Kal'gerion demons </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1155600607504257024.png?v=1" alt="kalgerion_demon" title="kalgerion_demon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b) Games necklace teleport to Corporeal Beast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212996726685749.png?v=1" alt="corporealbeast" title="corporealbeast" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and run northeast.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎c) Wilderness sword teleport to </nowiki><em><nowiki>herb patch</nowiki></em><nowiki> and run north, then east along the lava.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/fKZLfiGXqH.png <nowiki>Click here</nowiki>]<nowiki> to open a map of optimal routes for the above.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>⬥ If hunting elite spawns in the Wilderness, stay a few kills after the end of your task in case the &quot;forced spawn&quot; is delayed.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/zVTy9k8mLg.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Unless otherwise specified, stand in-between the lava pools to funnel the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107343123976284.png?v=1" alt="ripperdemon" title="ripperdemon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> onto one tile.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Ripper Demon Cave</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If killing Ripper Demons in the Ripper Demon cave; teleport to the Al Kharid lodestone </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552328005419038.png?v=1" alt="alkharidlode" title="alkharidlode" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and run southeast towards the cave entrance. They are </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> aggressive in this location.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/Hs3NllZKrA.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-low-effort-magic"><ins><nowiki>Method: Low Effort Magic</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is very effective at damage reduction and as such is a strong choice for killing Ripper Demons. Stacking Animate Dead </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Cryptbloom armour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336169336373339.png?v=1" alt="cryptbloomhelm" title="cryptbloomhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Infernal Puzzle Box </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1" alt="infernalpuzzlebox" title="infernalpuzzlebox" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Deflect Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with Amulet of souls </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1" alt="aos" title="aos" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Enhanced Devoted 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1" alt="enhdev4" title="enhdev4" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, should allow players to sustain themselves purely with Blood Barrage </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> healing alone.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Walk up and attack demons between steps. This is the most dangerous part of the method as the first few demons are the slowest to kill since </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is not active yet and you have no </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800572883025.png?v=1" alt="ruthless3" title="ruthless3" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks. Keep track of the demons on you and look out for jumps (refer to example video below).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure Legacy Combat Mode is active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1" alt="affliction" title="affliction" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Autocast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Activate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134307902816297.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofwen" title="scriptureofwen" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Drink </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> once you are comfortably set up with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>⬥ You must </nowiki></em><em><nowiki>target the Slasher Demon (elite)</nowiki></em><em><nowiki> when it spawns to kill it before the jump as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> deals only 60% to non-main targets.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>*⬥ In legacy, after almost every action the player should click on a ripper to prevent attacks from being delayed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Eating / drinking potions</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Looting</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Noting </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1" alt="ripperpouch" title="ripperpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki>*</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-low-effort-necromancy"><ins><nowiki>Method: Low Effort Necromancy</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Stacking Animate dead </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Cryptbloom armour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336169336373339.png?v=1" alt="cryptbloomhelm" title="cryptbloomhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Deathwarden armour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142770718468223027.png?v=1" alt="wardenhood90" title="wardenhood90" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Infernal Puzzle Box </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1" alt="infernalpuzzlebox" title="infernalpuzzlebox" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Hellhound </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Deflect Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with Amulet of souls </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1" alt="aos" title="aos" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Powder of protection </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1" alt="powderofprotection" title="powderofprotection" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and Enhanced Devoted 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1" alt="enhdev4" title="enhdev4" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, should allow players to only require inputs when Alt1 warnings go off.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>While setting up use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to help mitigate damage taken. This is the most dangerous part of the method as the first few demons are the slowest to kill. Keep track of the demons on you and look out for jumps (in case of a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1" alt="rod" title="rod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> proc refer to the third example video below).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1" alt="sorrow" title="sorrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1" alt="ruination" title="ruination" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1" alt="powderofprotection" title="powderofprotection" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if not using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158359724056.png?v=1" alt="aos" title="aos" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1" alt="prismofrestoration" title="prismofrestoration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to keep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> alive</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Activate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134307902816297.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofwen" title="scriptureofwen" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Slasher Demon (elite)</nowiki></strong><nowiki> spawns, you must do the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Right-click attack elite spawn.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (optionally use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921675845633.png?v=1" alt="demonslayer" title="demonslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1" alt="threadsoffate" title="threadsoffate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Continue as normal.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
